description: Read a single venue dossier by venue_id without spending a free reveal. Returns description, room layout, load-in and stairs notes, crowd vibe, The Scoop field notes, genres, and sample bands (for signed-in accounts and All Access), plus booking contacts, dead-email warnings, submission rules, typical ticket prices, usual music days, and the 20 dated shows nearest to today (when revealed or with All Access). Avoid calling get_venue in a loop over search results unless you need deeper room notes, stage specs, or dated show history for specific rooms.
name: get_venue
title: Get Venue Details
